title: Cornish Pasty with Thai Twist
description: A fusion of traditional Cornish pasty with Thai flavors, featuring zesty cornish style chicken filling.

ingredients.name: Fermented Filling
ingredients.notes: mix of fermented veggies and spices

ingredients.name: British Cottage Cheese
ingredients.notes: crumbly cottage cheese for added texture

ingredients.name: British Filled Pastry
ingredients.notes: flaky filling pastry for added flakiness

ingredients.name: Cornish Style Chicken
ingredients.notes: grilled or baked chicken for protein

instructions: Roll out Cornish Pasty Pastry and place on a baking sheet.
Spoon Fermented Filling and British Cottage Cheese mixture onto the center of the pastry.
Add Zesty Cheese and Ferment on top of the filling.
Fold the pastry to seal the pasty and crimp the edges.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Grill or bake Cornish Style Chicken separately and slice.
Serve pasty with chicken and additional Fermented Filling on the side.
